name: Sakuma Exports Ltd
about: Sakuma Exports Ltd. is engaged in  Buying, Processing, Marketing, Exporting bulk agricultural commodities like Sugar, Edible Oils, Oil Seeds, Pulses, Cotton, etc. It also offers innovative financial structured products linked to physical commodities. [1]
keyPoints:
Products
The company trades major bulk commodities such as Sugar, Edible Oil, Pulses, Lentils, Cotton, and other Agri commodities. [1]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.52 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 20.0%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -2.10% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 4.89% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.14.4 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 55.2 to 67.0 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -15.6%
